//Database: Provider selects which SQL to use: 'Local' (on-prem SQL Server -> ConnectionStrings:DefaultConnection) or 'Azure' (Azure SQL Database -> ConnectionStrings:AzureConnection).
//ConnectionStrings: Keep the real password OUT of source control: set it via env var (ConnectionStrings__AzureConnection or ConnectionStrings__DefaultConnection) or a user secret.
//DEV-MODE: SSO is intentionally OFF (blank TenantId/ClientId) so the /account/dev-login bypass is active. To switch to SSO, paste the //real-* values below back into Entra and set DevBypassEnabled to false.
//ApiSecurity: Self-service OAuth API hosted in-process (/connect/token + /api/selfservice/*), consumed by Partner Connect. ENABLED because SigningKey is set here. Clients[].ClientSecret is a PLAINTEXT shared secret (constant-time compared), not a hash, and MUST match Partner Connect's Api:ClientSecret (Api__ClientSecret). These values are committed here at the operator's request; prefer overriding them via Azure App Settings / Key Vault (ApiSecurity__SigningKey, ApiSecurity__Clients__0__ClientId, ApiSecurity__Clients__0__ClientSecret) and rotate them if the repo is exposed. Blank SigningKey => the endpoints are not mapped and the portal is unchanged.
//Notifications: AdminBaseUrl is the internal reviewer portal URL used to build links in the 'supplier submitted' email raised by /api/selfservice/submit.

Reports.//: Scheduled reports (Settings > Scheduled Reports). SchedulerEnabled turns the background runner on/off; PollSeconds is how often it checks for due schedules (min 15); TimeZone is the local zone admins enter/see schedule times in (IANA 'Asia/Dubai' or Windows 'Arabian Standard Time'). Attachments require Email:Graph or Email:Smtp — Database Mail cannot attach in-memory files.

Deployment.//Mode: Internal (full app + DB + Self-Service API) or Dmz (public self-service front-end calling the internal API).

BlobStorage.//: Azure Blob Storage for user-uploaded files (documents, photos, logos). Enabled=false stores files in the database even if a ConnectionString is set. When Enabled=true and a ConnectionString is set, NEW uploads go to blob; existing files keep working from their current location.

Email.//: Email delivery. Precedence: Microsoft Graph (when Email:Graph is fully filled) > SMTP (when Smtp:Host is set; required on Azure SQL, which has no Database Mail) > SQL Server Database Mail (using MailProfileName). Leave Email:Graph blank to keep the SMTP/Database Mail behaviour.

Graph.//: Microsoft Graph app-only (client-credentials) sender. Fill all four to enable. Sender is fixed to SenderUpn. Supply ClientSecret from an environment variable / key vault (Email__Graph__ClientSecret), never commit it. A 403 ErrorAccessDenied means the Exchange Application Access Policy excludes SenderUpn.
